name: When should I hire a finish carpenter for my kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a finish carpenter for my kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should hire a finish carpenter once the major structural work, plumbing, and electrical installations are complete, and after cabinets have been installed but before final painting or flooring in some cases. Finish carpenters work on the final decorative touches, so their involvement is crucial in the later stages of a remodel. This timing ensures that their detailed work is not damaged by other trades and that all elements fit together seamlessly for a professional result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a finish carpenter in the later stages of your kitchen remodel, after major structural work and cabinet installation, but before final painting or flooring.
